description: This file is a test double implementation of the TopicDao interface, providing stubbed and in-memory behavior for unit testing purposes of topic-related data interactions within the app.

classes.name: TestTopicDao
classes.description: A test double class that implements TopicDao, with in-memory state management for testing.

methods.name: getTopicEntity
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a TopicEntity for a given topicId; not used in tests.

methods.name: getTopicEntities
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of TopicEntity objects.

methods.name: getTopicEntities
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of TopicEntity objects filtered by a set of IDs.

methods.name: getOneOffTopicEntities
methods.description: Returns a list of one-off TopicEntity objects; default is empty list.

methods.name: insertOrIgnoreTopics
methods.description: Adds new TopicEntities to the internal state, ignoring duplicates based on ID.

methods.name: upsertTopics
methods.description: Updates or inserts TopicEntities, overwriting existing entries with matching IDs.

methods.name: deleteTopics
methods.description: Removes TopicEntities with specified IDs from internal state.
